question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting the shipped legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or close this issue and the linked PR as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through `skill_workshop`?
rationale: Automation can prove the release helper is affected and the linked PR fixes that old surface, but current main removed the helper and repository direction now points durable skill creation at Skill Workshop.

options.title: Close obsolete helper path
options.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together, documenting that current main no longer supports the initializer helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

options.title: Sponsor legacy helper repair
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR that intentionally restores or patches the helper, preserves current Skill Workshop guidance, and explains whether the fix is main-only or a release backport.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper path
recommendation.body: Close this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92126 together, documenting that current main no longer supports the initializer helper and `skill_workshop` is the supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: The original helper surface and product-boundary decision around bundled skills route most strongly through the initial bundled skill history.
